name: How do professionals remove smoke odors from a house?

mainEntity.name: How do professionals remove smoke odors from a house?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professionals use a multi-step process to remove smoke odors. This typically includes removing all smoke-damaged materials, thorough cleaning of all surfaces with specialized deodorizing agents, and air purification using equipment like ozone generators or hydroxyl machines. These machines break down smoke particles at a molecular level. Air duct cleaning is also essential to eliminate trapped odors and ensure fresh air circulation throughout the property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professionals remove smoke odors by clearing damaged materials, cleaning surfaces with deodorizers, and using ozone or hydroxyl machines for air purification, along with air duct cleaning.
